newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy will help crisis-hit industries - minister.
newsitem.headline: Italy will help crisis-hit industries - minister.

text.p: Industry minister Pierluigi Bersani has promised that the state will give aid to crisis-hit Italian industries, according to an interview in weekly financial magazine Mondo Economico.

In extracts of an article to be published on Monday, made available on Thursday, Bersani was quoted as saying that he would take a series of measures as soon as the 1997 budget law was approved by parliament, due by the end of this month.
Such measures "will not necessarily be traditional incentives, but could be in the form of revised regulations or fiscal adjustments," Bersani said.
They would be granted above all to those companies operating in the durable goods sector and which are having to face a heavy stagnation in consumer demand, Bersani said.
He gave no specific examples, but industry sources noted that car sector research groups in particular have called for incentives to boost flagging demand in the depressed Italian car market.
